title: Notification ask
summary: Asks for the system notification permission at the moment it helps: right after the person sends their first message (registries/onboarding.json prompts.notifications). A primer card comes first, so the one-shot iOS prompt is not wasted.

phase.description: primer: the Bipe card. asking: the system prompt is up. denied: the person said no in the system prompt or earlier.

recipientName.description: The name of the person the first message went to, for bipe_notifications_prompt_title. Absent in a group.

systemStatus.description: The platform permission (iOS authorization status; Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS; granted below Android 13).

trigger.effect: On the first sent message (trigger firstMessageSent): shows the primer when systemStatus is notDetermined and the card was not dismissed before.

allow.effect: Opens the system prompt. granted: starts push-registration.

notNow.effect: Dismisses the card for good on this phone. Notification settings can still turn notifications on.

notes: A refusal never blocks anything (onboarding.md: Permissions).
bipe_notifications_prompt_title takes the recipient's name; in a group or without a name use bipe_notifications_prompt_title_generic.
Card text and buttons come from the generated onboarding code (prompts.notifications).
